changeSet.comment: Dossiers, réglages, cycles et bulletins de paie.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE paie_dossiers ( tenantId TEXT NOT NULL, ressourceId TEXT NOT NULL, mode TEXT NOT NULL, frequence TEXT NOT NULL, tauxHoraire TEXT, salaireAnnuel TEXT, montantPersonnelFederal TEXT NOT NULL, montantPersonnelQuebec TEXT NOT NULL, modifieLe TEXT NOT NULL, modifiePar TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (tenantId, ressourceId) )

CREATE TABLE paie_reglages ( tenantId TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, tauxFss TEXT NOT NULL, tauxCnesst TEXT NOT NULL, majorationSupplementaire TEXT NOT NULL, modifieLe TEXT NOT NULL, modifiePar TEXT NOT NULL )

CREATE TABLE paie_cycles ( id TEXT NOT NULL, tenantId TEXT NOT NULL, debut TEXT NOT NULL, fin TEXT NOT NULL, datePaie TEXT NOT NULL, etat TEXT NOT NULL, prepareLe TEXT NOT NULL, preparePar TEXT NOT NULL, traiteLe TEXT, traitePar TEXT, PRIMARY KEY (tenantId, id) )

CREATE TABLE paie_bulletins ( id TEXT NOT NULL, tenantId TEXT NOT NULL, cycleId TEXT NOT NULL, ressourceId TEXT NOT NULL, matricule TEXT NOT NULL, nom TEXT NOT NULL, datePaie TEXT NOT NULL, heuresRegulieres TEXT NOT NULL, heuresSupplementaires TEXT NOT NULL, calcul TEXT NOT NULL, feuilles TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (tenantId, id) )
CREATE INDEX idx_paie_bulletins_cycle ON paie_bulletins (tenantId, cycleId)
CREATE INDEX idx_paie_bulletins_personne ON paie_bulletins (tenantId, ressourceId, datePaie)
